seo_title: Caltex Creators Case Study: 4 Distinct Territories | SOMIN
description: SOMIN mapped Caltex Malaysia's four creators, with 6.0M engagements in 90 days, into four distinct territories, each with an insight and a first move.
eyebrow: Creator case study · Fuel retail · Malaysia
h1: Caltex's four creators each own one territory, with none shared
lede: SOMIN read Caltex Malaysia's four activated creators over 90 days. They earned 6.0M engagements, 5.8M from @aydensng, and SOMIN gave each one distinct territory, an insight and a first move.
meta_line: A SOMIN creator strategy · Last 90 days · Malaysia

challenge.title: Turning Caltex's four-creator roster into a portfolio
challenge.body: Reach ranged from 5.8M engagements in 90 days to 203. Each creator needed a distinct conversation, with no overlap.

approach.title: Perspective studies and a panel whitespace study
points: Mapped the creators and panel in the Creators workspace.
Perspective studies split each creator's content into personas and tensions.
A panel whitespace study (n=1,365) and an Apr–Jul 2026 trend window (n=517) found open ground.
One Caltex-styled territory per creator, with a hero creative from the creative-expressions engine.

findings_title: One creator carries 5.8M of Caltex's 6.0M engagements

findings.title: Each creator has unclaimed ground to own
findings.body: Premium performance is open in @aydensng's lifestyle content; no brand links hip-hop credibility to engine performance, @joeflizzow's opening.

findings.title: Readiness runs from Ready to Own to Weak Signal
findings.body: Ready to Own for @aydensng, Differentiate for @joeflizzow, Emerging for @sonaone, Weak Signal (build) for @matthaios.

delivered.title: Four creator territories, each with insight and hero creative
points: The Aspirational Drive (@aydensng): 'Enjoy the Journey', with Techron as the quiet flex
Street Cred & Craft (@joeflizzow): Techron-truth through craft and no-compromise
The Everyday Groove (@sonaone): CaltexGO and Rewards value with music
The Next-Gen Connector (@matthaios): a trend-led, rewards-native Gen-Z community role

quote.text: Aspiration is the on-ramp: people follow the life they want before the fuel they buy.

outcome.title: Caltex gets one creator per territory, led by @aydensng
outcome.body: Each has a first move ready to brief: @aydensng leads, @matthaios is grown as a build. Figures show engagement, not sales.

faq.q: How did SOMIN assign the territories?
faq.a: Perspective studies read each creator; a panel whitespace study then found ground each could own without overlap.
No. Without GMV or affiliate data, every figure is 90-day content engagement, a proxy for reach.

faq.q: Why keep a creator with 203 engagements?
faq.a: @matthaios is an emerging Gen-Z voice, a Weak Signal (build) to grow as the community connector.
